criteria: Original SOL selection composed from grammatical categories, not copied from a third-party stop-word list. A bounded English spelling list, not an exhaustive grammar or a frequency threshold: include articles and determiners (including common quantifiers); personal, possessive, reflexive, relative, interrogative and demonstrative pronouns (including common literary thou/thee forms); simple single-token prepositions and conjunctions; be/have/do auxiliary forms and modal or semi-modal forms; negation; common auxiliary/negative contractions and hortative let's and a small set of additive, restrictive, deictic and phrasal-verb particles. Include am, are, be, been, is, was, were for their copular/auxiliary uses, but explicitly exclude being because its nominal philosophical use in Hegel must remain visible. Closed-class spellings that name logical determinations in the CORE edition stay visible: exclude other, one, many, beyond and itself as well. Itself carries the determinations in itself / for itself. Include have, has, had, having and do forms for auxiliary uses even though they also have lexical uses. Category labels document an inclusion reason, not context-sensitive part-of-speech tagging: a spelling with several roles is stored once under one inclusion reason, with whole contractions grouped together. Matching hides every occurrence of a listed spelling regardless of its actual role. Keep philosophical nouns and ordinary lexical verbs/adjectives/adverbs out unless independently included by a stated grammatical role. Exclude multiword expressions, detached apostrophe/clitic fragments and productive open-class compounds. Whole contractions remain whole tokens; no stemming, lemmatization or contraction expansion. Entries are sorted, unique NFC/casefold ESSENCE word tokens with straight internal apostrophes. This immutable v1 vocabulary is presentation-only, off by default, and is declared as a method choice; it never changes inputs, counts, denominators, scores, saved artifacts or exports. After release, a changed selection requires a new version/id.
